title: True Paxels
description: Save on inventory space and craft a paxel!
body:
I'm bringing the classic, all-in-one tool, to vanilla Minecraft with True Paxels.

This data pack adds new recipes that result in a paxel for every tool tier, combining the functionality of a pickaxe, an axe and a shovel into one singular tool. Mine stone, strip logs and flatten dirt paths without having to constantly swap between tools.

Features:
- Craftable wooden, stone, golden, copper, iron, diamond and netherite paxel
- Functions as a pickaxe, axe, and shovel in one tool
  - Mines stone, wood and dirt blocks
- Survival friendly

Paxels make everyday tasks faster and keep your hot bar free for the items you actually want to carry.

**NOTICE**

There is currently a bug with the new data component, "minecraft:block_transformer", that does not transform double blocks like copper doors and copper double chests.

Once this bug is patched, a trigger command will be added for players to properly modify the paxel into the desired full functioning tool.
